title: Idempotency: Same Visible Result
objective: Explain to software engineers that repeating the same operation produces the same externally visible result.

scenes.title: Core definition
scenes.visualNotes: Single full-screen built-in callout on atom-dark theme. Large high-contrast centered text with generous padding for immediate legibility at 1280x720. No mascot, logo, signature, or watermark. No subtitles. Deterministic frame-based hold with a subtle built-in text settle only if supported declaratively; otherwise static.
scenes.narrativeRole: Deliver the entire lesson in one memorable takeaway.
scenes.visualRole: Use the one required registered built-in callout scene as the sole visual so the concept is immediate and legible within 3 seconds.

propsPlan.text: Idempotent: repeat the operation, same externally visible result.

scenes.visualRationale: A single built-in callout is the clearest way to satisfy the 3-second limit, the exact-one-callout requirement, and the conceptual nature of the topic without unnecessary demo detail.
riskNotes: Keep text at large size and centered to ensure legibility in a 3-second web playback window.
Do not enable any branding, mascot, logo, signature, subtitles, music, SFX, or watermark.

notes: Target: target.video.001. Theme: atom-dark. Output: video/mp4, 1280x720, 16:9, web. Use deterministic frame-based rendering at 30 fps. Exactly one registered built-in callout scene is used. No external assets, no voiceover, no music, no sound effects, and no watermark. Intended to pass technical review.
